pov: 第一人称（Tris 特丽丝视角）＋现在时叙述

facts.event: 特丽丝与托比亚斯·伊顿（Tobias Eaton）约定当晚在他公寓见面，他把钥匙留在门框顶上，还打趣说她得跳起来才够得着——她真的跳了三次。
facts.receivers: the key / the door frame / his apartment
facts.text: We agreed to meet at his apartment tonight. He left the key for me on top of the door frame, joking that I’d have to jump to get it. And I do, actually—three times.

facts.event: 肖娜（Shauna）在托比亚斯公寓里截住特丽丝，先道歉说该早点解释，再自报是 Four（托比亚斯）的朋友，并说托比亚斯本来要在这里见她，但她认为他可能需要特丽丝帮忙。
facts.text: “Sorry, I should have explained.” She closes the door behind her and sticks out her hand. “I’m Shauna. Four’s friend. I know he’s supposed to meet you here, but . . .” She pauses, and bites her lip. “I think he might need your help.”

facts.event: 在靶场，托比亚斯没有回应肖娜叫他“Four”，而是继续开火：一枚针打中靶子、落在靶心外侧；特丽丝起初看不出她为何担心，看久了才发现他手在抖、耳后冒汗。
facts.text: He fires, instead. A needle hits the target just shy of the center. At first, I can’t see why she’s so worried. He just looks like himself. But the longer I look, the more the cracks show. The way his hands tremble. The sweat curling behind his ear.

facts.event: 托比亚斯告诉特丽丝，珍宁·马修斯（Jeanine Matthews）当天来看过他；说话时他握着她手的那只手，在他肋侧的火焰纹身上抽搐了一下。
facts.text: “Jeanine Matthews came to see me today.” His hand convulses where it holds mine, still right against the flames on his side.

facts.event: 托比亚斯说珍宁的借口是她需要更新电脑，但他认为真正的原因是要测试他——让他走一遍恐惧模拟。
facts.text: “Her excuse was that she needed to update the computer. But I think the real reason might have been to test me. To see me go through a fear simulation.”

facts.event: 托比亚斯说珍宁如今已确认阿布尼格申确有丑闻，就会发布一份点名的报告；而自看穿他真实身份起就一直勒索他的埃里克（Eric），会告诉无畏派那份报告写的就是他。
facts.text: “And now,” he says, and his next swallow is labored. “And now, she’ll release a report naming names, now that she has confirmation of a real Abnegation scandal. And Eric, who’s been blackmailing me to keep me in line ever since he figured out who I really am, will tell the Dauntless that I’m the one the report is about.”

facts.event: 托比亚斯要特丽丝去找伊芙琳（Evelyn）谈成交易：给她看那颗子弹、说她要加入她杀马库斯的计划，作为交换，把她想要了很久的东西——他自己——带给她。
facts.text: “You’ll go to Evelyn and you’ll make a deal. Show her the bullet, tell her you want in on her plan to kill Marcus—and whatever follows. And in exchange, you’ll bring her something she’s wanted for a long time: me.”

facts.event: 托比亚斯应下“行”，一手环住特丽丝的腰把她举起来，惹她笑出声；她任自己去想：若他愿意，会把她抱到哪里去。
facts.text: “Yeah, all right.” He puts an arm around my waist and lifts me up, startling a laugh out of me. It’s so easy for him to lift me, and for just a moment I let myself think about where he could carry me, if he decided to.

relations: 特丽丝（Tris）与托比亚斯·伊顿（Tobias Eaton，无畏派代号 Four）是恋人：她夜里进他的公寓等他，他在末尾把她举起来抱她。
肖娜（Shauna）是 Four 在无畏派的朋友，也是穿电光绿镶边制服的无畏派急救员；是她把特丽丝从公寓带到靶场。
珍宁·马修斯（Jeanine Matthews）是博学派领袖，把托比亚斯当作可测试、可控的对象；埃里克（Eric）长期以托比亚斯的真实身份勒索他。
伊芙琳（Evelyn）是托比亚斯的母亲、无派别激进派的头目；托比亚斯提议用“投奔母亲”替特丽丝换取她的信任。
马库斯·伊顿（Marcus Eaton）是托比亚斯的父亲，也是特丽丝提议要夺走权力的对象。
